Hey, my name is **Chris**. Welcome to my cozy little sandbox on the internet.

I’m a passion-driven, detail-oriented individual. I look for gaps others overlook and build elegant solutions to fill them, refining each feature until it’s fast, clear, and intuitive. I pair modern design with clean, structured code and an efficient, AI-assisted workflow that gets the job done and produces polished outputs.

The pinned repositories below feature my finest work; do take a moment to check them out.
